result:
Round 100 is implemented and ready for C. Holding Enter on the focused ▶ მოუსმინე button now toggles the preview once. In Chromium, 4 keydowns used to give 4 clicks and leave the preview stopped (▶). They now give 1 click and it stays playing (■). Typecheck, lint, Biome and the targeted tests pass, and nothing is committed.

**Changes** (`git status`: 3 M + 1 ??, HEAD still `e2412db`, frozen list 531/531 OK):
- `ArrangementLibraryPreview.tsx`: added the same `onKeyDown` as ＋ to the toggle button. It only calls `preventDefault()` on a repeated Enter. No `stopPropagation`, and nothing else on the button changed.
- `library-preview.test.tsx`: appended tests HT1–HT3 without changing existing lines. B's task put the last existing `it` at l.285; in the snapshot it ends at l.286, so the new hunk starts at l.287.
- Doc 087: only the status line (l.4) changed, to `C PASS (Round 99), გამოქვეყნდა e2412db (D-29z64)`.
- New Georgian doc 088, with its status set to waiting for C.

**Tests:**
- **Fail-before:** only HT1 fails on the baseline, which matches B's list.
- **Mutations:** a → HT1, b → HT3, c → HT3, d → HT1 and HT2. I added an extra mutation e (also blocking repeated Space) → HT3. With no mutation, 7/7 pass.
- **HT3 differs from B's wording:** my first version also checked that the repeated Enter was prevented, which made it fail on the baseline. I dropped those two checks, so HT3 now only checks that `'q'` and Space are not prevented and that the event still reaches a `document` listener. HT1 already proves the prevention. The first version's results are saved in `a-round-100/mutations-v1.log`. C should look at this in its test review (AN-REVIEW).
- **Checks:** `npm run typecheck` passed. `npm run lint` passed with 218 warnings, none in my files. Biome on the component and test file was clean. The 4 targeted test files passed 30/30. I did not run the full suite, build or `verify`; those are for the root gate.

**Code-reviewer:** the real subagent ran and scored it 9/10, with no Critical, High or Medium findings. I fixed all three Lows: the Space check in HT3, the "six places" wording in doc 088, and doc 088 now says the toggle works once in either direction. Its Architecture note is copied word for word into `a-round-100.md` for B. It suggests one shared helper for the four identical button guards, already tracked as `ARCH-R97-EXPORT-FOOTER-KEYBOARD`; I made no change for it this round.

**Not done by me:** audio level (RMS) measurement, the 1440×900 viewport, the regression rows, and browsers other than Chromium. Those are C's rows. I am not claiming any C acceptance row.

**Next for C:**
- HOLD-TOGGLE at 1280 and 1440.
- At 1280: FRESH-TOGGLE, WAVE-REG, HOLD-PLUS-REG, HOLD-ROW-REG and EXPORT-REG.
- PX-NET, REG-HYD, and G100-3 run on its own (the fake-Bearer part is blocked because there is no backend in the cloud).
- AN-REVIEW and T100-TARGETED (expect 4 files, 30 tests).
- SOURCE-UNCHANGED, checked against `a-round-100/end-hashes.txt`.

Everything is in `tmp/studio-real-loop/`: `a-round-100.md` and `a-round-100-result.json` are the report; the browser before/after results, screenshots, mutation script, logs and end hashes are in `a-round-100/`.
